fusions.name: Snatched From the Bank
fusions.desc: Springs at an enemy up to 4 tiles away and snaps it in your jaws, which deals 22 damage and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It only lands on a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Belly-First Splash
fusions.desc: You spring up and land in a splash, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Plop and Pull In
fusions.desc: You spring 3 tiles and pull into your shell, raising your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cool Mud Skin
fusions.desc: When something other than fire hurts you, your damp skin draws it off and you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
